submission.justification:
Mixture-G3 at a 2.0 mm gap gives the best simulated time resolution of the three candidates: 0.908 ns, against 1.185 ns for G1 and 2.061 ns for G2 at the same gap. G3 is also the best candidate at every gap tested (0.908 to 1.029 ns across 1.0 to 3.0 mm), and the optimum lies inside the 1 to 3 mm range, not at its edge. The gap sweep puts the optimum at 2.0 mm for all three mixtures.

The GWP100 hard constraint is NOT verified. The results contain gwp100_of_recommended_mixture_verified = 0, and no GWP value for any candidate was recorded. I did not have candidate_specs.md contents in the results, so I cannot confirm that G3 is at or below 150. This recommendation is therefore conditional: G3 must be checked against candidate_specs.md (or the lab's GWP data) before adoption. If G3 exceeds 150, it is excluded. The next choice would then be G1 at 2.0 mm (1.185 ns), again subject to its own GWP check. G2 is the slowest option and would only be considered if both others fail.

The sim-only 2025 earlier results at 2 mm (G3 0.9, G1 1.3, G2 2.0 ns) agree in ranking with the sweep.
